data.one_liner: Micro-framework for Flutter with boilerplate, routing, MVC pattern, and CLI tooling.
data.what_it_does: Nylo is a micro-framework that simplifies Flutter app development by providing a structured project boilerplate, an MVC pattern, routing, state management, and an integrated CLI tool (Metro) for generating project files and managing apps.
use_when: You want a structured MVC architecture and boilerplate for a new Flutter project
You need built-in routing, localization, theme management, and API networking helpers out of the box
avoid_when: You are adding to an existing, highly custom architecture where a full micro-framework is unnecessary
You prefer minimal unopinionated packages over a heavy framework structure
strengths: Provides a complete ecosystem including routing, state management, and form handling
CLI tool (Metro) speeds up generating files, running checks, and creating playbooks
Includes built-in support for light/dark themes and localization
weaknesses: Tight coupling to the Nylo framework and its supported patterns
Can be difficult to migrate away from once adopted due to deep framework integration
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing a Nylo project structure and configuring core project files as outlined in the documentation.
